senses.en: easy to press, bend, or change in shape
gentle and not loud, bright, or harsh
not strict or severe enough

ex.en: This soft blanket keeps me warm on chilly evenings.
ex.zh: 这条柔软的毯子让我在寒冷的夜晚保持温暖。

ex.en: Soft lighting and comfortable furniture can make hospital waiting areas feel less stressful for patients.
ex.zh: 柔和的灯光和舒适的家具可以减轻患者在医院候诊区的紧张感。

tip: soft是形容词；修饰说话等动作通常用softly。

senses.en: The earth in which plants grow.
To make something dirty.

ex.en: She filled the pot with soil and planted seeds.
ex.zh: 她往花盆里填了土，然后种下种子。

ex.en: Intensive farming can damage soil quality, reducing the land's ability to support crops over time.
ex.zh: 集约化农业可能损害土壤质量，逐渐降低土地种植作物的能力。

tip: 土壤一般不可数；不同土质可用复数soils。

senses.en: Relating to the sun.
Using energy from sunlight to produce heat or electricity.

ex.en: We wore special protective glasses to watch the solar eclipse.
ex.zh: 我们戴着专用防护眼镜观看日食。

ex.en: Investment in solar energy can reduce dependence on fossil fuels and create jobs in rural communities.
ex.zh: 投资太阳能可以减少对化石燃料的依赖，并为农村社区创造就业机会。

tip: solar是形容词，常用于太阳或太阳能相关搭配。

senses.en: a person who serves in an army

ex.en: The soldier helped carry supplies across the flooded road.
ex.zh: 那名士兵帮忙把物资运过被洪水淹没的道路。

ex.en: Soldiers can support emergency services by delivering food and rescuing residents after major natural disasters.
ex.zh: 重大自然灾害发生后，军人可以通过运送食物和救助居民来支援应急部门。

col: serve as a soldier｜当兵服役
tip: 通常指陆军军人；水手和飞行员另有专称。

senses.en: Find an answer to a problem or mystery

ex.en: We solved the puzzle together after dinner last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚晚饭后，我们一起解开了那道谜题。

ex.en: Improving public transport could help solve traffic problems in rapidly growing urban areas.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通有助于解决快速发展城区的交通问题。

tip: solve直接接问题；“溶解”用dissolve。

senses.en: An unspecified amount or number of something.
An unspecified number or amount of people or things.
Approximately, used before an amount or number.

ex.en: I bought some fresh bread on my way home.
ex.zh: 我在回家的路上买了些新鲜面包。

ex.en: Some residents support the proposed cycle lanes, while others worry about losing parking spaces.
ex.zh: 一些居民支持拟建的自行车道，另一些人则担心停车位会减少。

tip: 可修饰复数名词或不可数名词；弱读常为/səm/。

senses.en: a person whose identity is unknown or not stated

ex.en: Somebody left a blue umbrella beside the front door.
ex.zh: 有人把一把蓝色雨伞落在了前门旁边。

ex.en: Students are more likely to seek help when they know somebody will listen without judging them.
ex.zh: 如果学生知道有人会倾听而不评判他们，就更有可能寻求帮助。

col: somebody to talk to｜可以倾诉的人
tip: 作主语时谓语用单数；回指常用they。

senses.en: A thing that is not named or specified.

ex.en: There is something soft inside this little box.
ex.zh: 这个小盒子里有个柔软的东西。

ex.en: Learning something new every day can help adults remain curious and adapt to changes in the workplace.
ex.zh: 每天学习一点新东西，有助于成年人保持好奇心并适应职场变化。

tip: 修饰词放后面，如something useful；作主语用单数。

senses.en: on certain occasions, but not always or regularly

ex.en: I sometimes take the longer route home through the park.
ex.zh: 我有时会绕远路穿过公园回家。

ex.en: Working from home sometimes improves productivity, although its benefits depend on suitable equipment and a quiet environment.
ex.zh: 居家办公有时能提高效率，不过其益处取决于合适的设备和安静的环境。

tip: sometimes是有时；some time是一段时间。

senses.en: in or to a place that is not specified
approximately, when used before an amount or range

ex.en: I left my keys somewhere near the sofa.
ex.zh: 我把钥匙落在沙发附近的某个地方了。

ex.en: Young people need somewhere affordable to live before they can fully participate in the local economy.
ex.zh: 年轻人需要有负担得起的住所，才能充分参与当地的经济活动。

tip: 形容词放后面：somewhere quiet；前面通常不加to。

senses.en: A male child in relation to his parents.

ex.en: Their son helped them plant flowers in the garden.
ex.zh: 他们的儿子帮他们在花园里种花。

ex.en: Parents should give their sons and daughters equal opportunities to pursue education and develop practical skills.
ex.zh: 父母应给予儿子和女儿平等的机会，让他们接受教育并培养实用技能。

tip: son与sun同音；成年男性也仍是父母的son。

ex.en: We sang a happy song together.
ex.zh: 我们一起唱了一首欢快的歌。

ex.en: This song helps me remember the new words.
ex.zh: 这首歌帮助我记住新单词。

col: a popular song｜一首流行歌曲
tip: 小学教材补充词：先听发音，再结合例句理解，最后用这个词说一句自己的话。
note: 依据小学教材词表整理；释义、例句与插画为本站补充内容，不属于词光官方原词条。

senses.en: After a short time from now or another stated time.

ex.en: Dinner will be ready soon, so wash your hands.
ex.zh: 晚饭很快就好了，去洗手吧。

ex.en: Unless cities improve public transport soon, traffic congestion is likely to become increasingly severe.
ex.zh: 除非城市尽快改善公共交通，否则交通拥堵很可能日益严重。

tip: as soon as引导将来时间从句时，通常用一般现在时。

senses.en: painful, especially when touched or moved
a painful damaged area on the skin
upset or annoyed about something unfair or disappointing

ex.en: My legs are sore after yesterday's long walk.
ex.zh: 昨天走了很远的路，我的腿现在酸痛。

ex.en: Office workers may develop sore muscles if they remain seated without taking regular breaks.
ex.zh: 上班族如果久坐而不定时休息，可能会出现肌肉酸痛。

tip: sore常修饰身体部位，如a sore throat。

senses.en: feeling regret about something you did or something that happened
feeling sadness or sympathy because of someone's difficulties

ex.en: I'm sorry I spilled juice on your clean shirt.
ex.zh: 很抱歉，我把果汁洒在了你的干净衬衫上。

ex.en: Although companies may say they are sorry for environmental damage, meaningful action is needed to restore public trust.
ex.zh: 尽管企业可能对环境破坏表示歉意，但恢复公众信任需要切实行动。

col: sorry for being late｜为迟到感到抱歉
sorry about the mistake｜为错误感到抱歉
feel sorry for someone｜同情某人
sorry to hear that｜听到那件事很难过
tip: sorry for doing表示为所做之事道歉。

senses.en: a group of things sharing similar characteristics
to arrange things in groups or a particular order
to deal successfully with a problem or practical matter

ex.en: What sort of music do you listen to at home?
ex.zh: 你在家听哪种音乐？

ex.en: Households should sort their waste carefully so that recyclable materials can be processed more efficiently.
ex.zh: 家庭应仔细将垃圾分类，以便更高效地处理可回收材料。

col: sort out a problem｜解决问题
tip: a sort of表示“一种”；sort of也可口语表示“有点”。

senses.en: The spiritual part of a person, separate from the body.
A person, especially when describing their character.
Expressive popular music combining gospel and rhythm and blues.

ex.en: Walking beside the sea always seems to soothe my soul.
ex.zh: 在海边散步似乎总能抚慰我的心灵。

ex.en: Many cultural traditions view the soul as something that continues to exist after the body dies.
ex.zh: 许多文化传统认为，灵魂在肉体死亡后仍然存在。

col: a kind soul｜心地善良的人
not a soul｜一个人也没有
tip: not a soul意为一个人也没有，不是没有灵魂。

senses.en: something you hear
to seem a certain way when heard, or produce noise
sensible, reliable, or in good condition

ex.en: The sound of rain woke me before sunrise.
ex.zh: 天还没亮，雨声就把我吵醒了。

ex.en: Environmental policies should be based on sound scientific evidence rather than assumptions about public behaviour.
ex.zh: 环境政策应以可靠的科学证据为基础，而非对公众行为的假设。

tip: sound后接形容词；sound like后接名词。

senses.en: A liquid food made by cooking ingredients in water or stock.

ex.en: She warmed her hands around a bowl of soup.
ex.zh: 她双手捧着一碗汤取暖。

ex.en: Community kitchens can provide affordable vegetable soup to help residents access nutritious meals during difficult economic periods.
ex.zh: 社区厨房可以提供价格实惠的蔬菜汤，帮助居民在经济困难时期获得有营养的餐食。

tip: 通常不可数；点餐时two soups可指两份汤。

senses.en: Having a sharp taste like a lemon.
Having an unpleasant taste or smell after becoming spoiled.
To become less pleasant or make a relationship worse.

ex.en: These grapes are too sour for my taste.
ex.zh: 这些葡萄对我来说太酸了。

ex.en: Disagreements over shared resources can sour relations between neighbouring countries and delay important environmental projects.
ex.zh: 共享资源方面的分歧可能使邻国关系恶化，并延误重要的环境项目。

tip: go sour可指食物变质，也可指关系变坏。

senses.en: the direction opposite north
in, towards, or facing the south
towards or in the south

ex.en: Our balcony faces south and gets plenty of sunshine.
ex.zh: 我们的阳台朝南，阳光很充足。

ex.en: Many families move to the south because its warmer climate allows more outdoor activities throughout the year.
ex.zh: 许多家庭搬到南方，因为那里气候更温暖，全年都能进行更多户外活动。

tip: 南部用in the south；向南用go south，不加to。

senses.en: Located in, coming from, or relating to the south.

ex.en: We spent a week exploring the island's southern coast.
ex.zh: 我们花了一周探索这座岛的南部海岸。

ex.en: Southern regions of the country may face longer droughts as rising temperatures increase pressure on water supplies.
ex.zh: 随着气温升高加大供水压力，该国南部地区可能面临更持久的干旱。

tip: south中/ou/读/aʊ/，southern中的元音读/ʌ/。

senses.en: Room available for something, or a gap between things
The vast area beyond Earth's atmosphere
To arrange things with gaps between them

ex.en: There is enough space for your bike beside mine.
ex.zh: 我的自行车旁边有足够的地方放你的车。

ex.en: Providing more green space in crowded neighbourhoods can improve residents' wellbeing and encourage outdoor physical activity.
ex.zh: 在人口密集的社区增加绿地，可以改善居民身心健康并鼓励户外锻炼。

tip: 泛指空间、太空时不可数；具体车位等可数。

senses.en: A vehicle designed to travel or operate in space.

ex.en: We watched the spacecraft launch from our garden.
ex.zh: 我们在花园里观看了航天器发射。

ex.en: Unmanned spacecraft allow scientists to explore distant planets without putting human lives at risk.
ex.zh: 无人航天器让科学家能够探索遥远的行星，而不危及人的生命。

col: reusable spacecraft｜可重复使用的航天器
tip: 单复数同形：one spacecraft，two spacecraft。

senses.en: A vehicle designed to travel through space.

ex.en: The children built a spaceship from cardboard boxes.
ex.zh: 孩子们用纸板箱做了一艘宇宙飞船。

ex.en: Designing a spaceship for long journeys requires careful planning to protect astronauts from radiation and isolation.
ex.zh: 设计用于长途航行的宇宙飞船需要周密规划，以保护宇航员免受辐射和孤独的影响。

col: board a spaceship｜登上宇宙飞船
launch a spaceship｜发射宇宙飞船
aboard a spaceship｜在宇宙飞船上
tip: spaceship可数；spacecraft的单复数形式相同。

senses.en: Pasta shaped into long, thin strands.

ex.en: She twirled the spaghetti around her fork before taking a bite.
ex.zh: 她先用叉子卷起意大利细面，再吃了一口。

ex.en: Simple meals such as spaghetti with vegetables can help students eat affordably while maintaining a balanced diet.
ex.zh: 蔬菜意大利面等简单餐食，可以帮助学生在节省开支的同时保持均衡饮食。

col: a plate of spaghetti｜一盘意大利细面
tip: 不可数名词；一盘用a plate of spaghetti。

senses.en: a country in southwestern Europe

ex.en: We travelled around Spain by train last summer.
ex.zh: 去年夏天，我们乘火车游览了西班牙。

ex.en: Spain attracts international visitors through its cultural heritage, varied landscapes, and well-developed tourism infrastructure.
ex.zh: 西班牙凭借文化遗产、多样的景观和完善的旅游基础设施吸引国际游客。

col: travel to Spain｜前往西班牙旅行
tip: 国名首字母大写，前面通常不加the。

senses.en: the language spoken in Spain and many Latin American countries
relating to Spain, its people, culture, or language

ex.en: I practise Spanish with my neighbour after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后我和邻居一起练习西班牙语。

ex.en: Learning Spanish can broaden students' access to literature and improve their opportunities for international employment.
ex.zh: 学习西班牙语能拓宽学生接触文学作品的渠道，并增加他们在国际就业市场上的机会。

tip: 首字母大写；一个西班牙人可说a Spanish person。

senses.en: extra and available to use when needed
to give time or resources that you can make available
to prevent someone from experiencing harm or difficulty

ex.en: I keep a spare umbrella in my car.
ex.zh: 我在车里放了一把备用伞。

ex.en: People who can spare a few hours each week could support local charities through regular volunteering.
ex.zh: 每周能抽出几个小时的人，可以通过定期做志愿者来支持当地慈善机构。

col: spare a moment｜抽出一点时间
tip: spare time是空闲时间；spare作动词可指抽出。

senses.en: Use your voice to say words or communicate with someone.
Be able to communicate in a particular language.
Address an audience about a subject.

ex.en: Could I speak to you after the lesson?
ex.zh: 下课后我能和你谈谈吗？

ex.en: Students who speak more than one language may find it easier to communicate across cultural boundaries.
ex.zh: 会说多种语言的学生可能更容易进行跨文化交流。

tip: 过去式spoke，过去分词spoken；语言前不用介词。

senses.en: a person who gives a talk or addresses others
a person who speaks a particular language
a device that produces sound from electrical signals

ex.en: The speaker made everyone laugh with her opening story.
ex.zh: 演讲者开场讲的故事把大家都逗笑了。

ex.en: Inviting a guest speaker from the scientific community can help students understand how classroom knowledge applies to real problems.
ex.zh: 邀请科学界的嘉宾来演讲，可以帮助学生理解课堂知识如何应用于实际问题。

tip: a native speaker of English指英语母语者。

senses.en: Different from usual, often in an important or valued way.
Intended for a particular purpose or person.
A specially priced product or a featured restaurant dish.

ex.en: We saved this special cake for your birthday.
ex.zh: 我们把这个特别的蛋糕留到了你生日时享用。

ex.en: Schools should provide special equipment so that students with disabilities can participate fully in classroom activities.
ex.zh: 学校应提供专用设备，让残障学生能够充分参与课堂活动。

tip: specially强调专门；especially常表示尤其。

senses.en: A formal talk given to an audience.
The ability or act of expressing thoughts through spoken words.

ex.en: Leila practised her speech in front of the mirror.
ex.zh: 莱拉对着镜子练习演讲。

ex.en: In his speech, the researcher explained how access to green spaces can improve children's mental health.
ex.zh: 研究人员在演讲中解释了接触绿地如何改善儿童的心理健康。

tip: 一次演讲用a speech；说话能力通常不可数。

senses.en: How fast something moves, happens, or operates
To move or travel very fast
To drive faster than the legal limit

ex.en: The train picked up speed as we left town.
ex.zh: 我们离开小镇时，火车加快了速度。

ex.en: Reducing vehicle speeds near schools can significantly improve road safety for children walking or cycling to class.
ex.zh: 降低学校附近的车速，可以显著提高步行或骑车上学的儿童的道路安全。

tip: speed up表示加快；speed也可作动词指超速驾驶。

senses.en: To write or say the letters of a word in order.
A period during which a particular condition or activity continues.
Words or magic believed to have special powers.

ex.en: Could you spell your surname slowly for me, please?
ex.zh: 请你把姓氏慢慢拼给我听，好吗？

ex.en: A prolonged spell of dry weather can reduce crop yields and increase pressure on local water supplies.
ex.zh: 持续的干旱天气会降低农作物产量，并加大当地供水压力。

col: a spell of illness｜一段患病期
tip: 过去式及过去分词英式可用spelt或spelled。

senses.en: to use money to pay for something
to use time doing something or being somewhere

ex.en: We spent all our money on fresh fruit.
ex.zh: 我们把钱全花在了新鲜水果上。

ex.en: Governments should spend more on preventive healthcare to reduce the future costs of treating chronic diseases.
ex.zh: 政府应增加预防保健方面的支出，以减少未来治疗慢性病的费用。

tip: 用spend时间doing或spend钱on；过去式spent。

senses.en: Inner strength, courage, or enthusiasm
A person's soul or a being without a physical body
A strong alcoholic drink made by distillation

ex.en: Even after losing, our team showed great spirit.
ex.zh: 即使输了比赛，我们队仍展现出昂扬的斗志。

ex.en: Community projects can strengthen a spirit of cooperation and encourage residents to take pride in their neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 社区项目能够增强合作精神，并鼓励居民为自己的社区感到自豪。

col: a spirit of cooperation｜合作精神
tip: 表示“情绪”或泛指“烈酒”时，常用复数spirits。

senses.en: A utensil with a small bowl for eating or serving.
To move or serve food using a spoon.

ex.en: She stirred her soup with a wooden spoon.
ex.zh: 她用木勺搅了搅汤。

ex.en: Teaching children to use a spoon independently can help develop their coordination and confidence.
ex.zh: 教孩子独立使用勺子有助于培养他们的协调能力和自信心。

col: spoon into a bowl｜用勺舀入碗中
tip: 一勺的量通常用 a spoonful of 表达。

senses.en: Physical activities involving skill, effort, and often competition
To wear or display something in a noticeable way

ex.en: Swimming is the only sport my sister really enjoys.
ex.zh: 游泳是我姐姐唯一真正喜欢的运动。

ex.en: Regular participation in sport can improve physical health and help young people develop teamwork skills.
ex.zh: 经常参加体育运动能改善身体健康，并帮助年轻人培养团队合作能力。

col: take part in sport｜参加体育运动
tip: 泛指体育时英式常用sport，美式常用sports。

senses.en: To reach, or make something reach, more people or places
To open something out or cover a surface with something
The process of reaching a wider area or more people

ex.en: She spread a blanket under the tree for our picnic.
ex.zh: 她在树下铺了一条毯子，供我们野餐用。

ex.en: The rapid spread of false information online highlights the importance of teaching critical reading skills in schools.
ex.zh: 虚假信息在网上迅速传播，凸显了学校教授批判性阅读技能的重要性。

col: the spread of disease｜疾病的传播
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为spread。

senses.en: the season between winter and summer
a coiled piece of metal that stretches or compresses
a place where water flows naturally out of the ground

ex.en: We plant flowers in the garden every spring.
ex.zh: 我们每年春天都在花园里种花。

ex.en: Warmer temperatures in spring can cause plants to flower earlier, affecting insects that depend on them.
ex.zh: 春季气温升高会使植物提前开花，影响依赖这些植物的昆虫。

tip: 季节前通常用in；泉和弹簧义均为可数名词。

senses.en: a shape with four equal sides and four right angles
an open public area surrounded by buildings
shaped like a square, or expressing area in squared units

ex.en: Fold the paper into a square before cutting it.
ex.zh: 先把纸折成正方形，再剪。

ex.en: Creating a public square can encourage social interaction and provide space for cultural events in crowded cities.
ex.zh: 在拥挤的城市中，建设公共广场可以促进社交互动，并为文化活动提供空间。

tip: 面积用square metres；长度用metres，勿混淆。

senses.en: A small rodent with a bushy tail, often living in trees.
To store something secretly for later use, usually with away.

ex.en: A squirrel buried a nut beside our garden gate.
ex.zh: 一只松鼠在我们花园门旁埋了一颗坚果。

ex.en: Urban parks provide squirrels with food and shelter, although feeding them can alter their natural behaviour.
ex.zh: 城市公园为松鼠提供食物和栖身之所，但投喂可能改变它们的自然行为。

tip: 作动词通常用squirrel away，指悄悄储存。

senses.en: unlikely to change suddenly, fall, or become worse
a building where horses are kept

ex.en: The table feels stable now that we tightened its legs.
ex.zh: 我们把桌腿拧紧后，桌子现在感觉稳固了。

ex.en: A stable income allows families to plan for future expenses and reduces their dependence on emergency financial assistance.
ex.zh: 稳定的收入让家庭能够规划未来开支，并减少对紧急经济援助的依赖。

col: in a stable condition｜情况稳定
tip: 作形容词指稳定；作可数名词指马厩。

senses.en: a large sports venue with seating around a central area

ex.en: Fans filled the stadium before the football match began.
ex.zh: 足球比赛开始前，球迷们就坐满了体育场。

ex.en: Building a new stadium may attract visitors, but its long-term maintenance costs require careful consideration.
ex.zh: 修建新体育场或许能吸引游客，但其长期维护费用需要仔细考虑。

col: packed stadium｜座无虚席的体育场
tip: 复数可用stadiums或stadia，前者更常见。

senses.en: A particular period or step in a process.
A raised area where performers appear before an audience.
To organise and present a performance or public event.

ex.en: The cake is cooling at this stage of preparation.
ex.zh: 制作进行到这个阶段，蛋糕正在冷却。

ex.en: Early intervention at a critical stage of childhood can significantly improve educational outcomes later in life.
ex.zh: 在童年的关键阶段及早干预，能显著改善日后的教育成果。

col: at an early stage｜在早期阶段
a stage of development｜发展阶段
tip: 表示阶段常用at a stage；表示在舞台上用on stage。

senses.en: A small official sticker showing that postage has been paid.
A tool that presses a mark, or the mark it leaves.
Press a mark onto something, or bring a foot down hard.

ex.en: She put a stamp on the envelope before leaving.
ex.zh: 她出门前在信封上贴了一张邮票。

ex.en: Although digital communication has reduced letter writing, collecting stamps remains a way to explore history and culture.
ex.zh: 尽管数字通信减少了书信往来，集邮仍是一种探索历史与文化的方式。

col: stamp a passport｜在护照上盖章
tip: 邮票用a stamp；“在信封上贴邮票”用put a stamp on。

senses.en: A required or achieved level of quality or performance.
Generally accepted, regularly used, or meeting an established requirement.

ex.en: The food here is always of a high standard.
ex.zh: 这里的食物品质一向很高。

ex.en: Governments should enforce strict safety standards to ensure that new housing protects residents from avoidable risks.
ex.zh: 政府应严格执行安全标准，确保新建住房保护居民免受可避免的风险。

tip: 达到标准用meet a standard；生活水平用standard of living。

senses.en: a huge ball of hot gas shining in space
a famous or exceptionally successful performer or other person
to play a leading role or feature someone doing so

ex.en: We watched the stars from our tent beside the lake.
ex.zh: 我们在湖边的帐篷里仰望星空。

ex.en: Light pollution prevents many urban residents from seeing stars, reducing their connection with the natural night sky.
ex.zh: 光污染使许多城市居民看不到星星，削弱了他们与自然夜空的联系。

col: a rising star｜冉冉升起的新星
star in a film｜主演电影
tip: star in表示“主演”；过去式starred，进行式starring。

senses.en: To begin doing something or cause something to begin.
To make a machine operate, or begin operating.
The moment or place where something begins.

ex.en: We started cooking dinner as soon as we got home.
ex.zh: 我们一到家就开始做晚饭。

ex.en: Schools should start teaching financial skills early so that young people can make informed decisions about money.
ex.zh: 学校应尽早开始教授理财技能，让年轻人能在充分了解情况后作出财务决定。

col: at the start of｜在……开始时
make a fresh start｜重新开始
tip: start doing与start to do通常都可表示开始做某事。

senses.en: the condition of someone or something at a particular time
a country, its government, or a region within a country
to express something clearly in speech or writing

ex.en: The kitchen was in a terrible state after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，厨房一片狼藉。

ex.en: The report states that reliable public transport is essential for reducing dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 报告指出，可靠的公共交通对于减少对私家车的依赖至关重要。

col: in a good state｜处于良好状态
tip: state作动词较正式，可接that从句；名词可指状态或国家。

senses.en: A place where trains or buses stop for passengers.
A place or organisation providing a particular service.
To place someone somewhere to perform a duty.

ex.en: We hurried to the station with our heavy suitcases.
ex.zh: 我们提着沉重的行李箱匆忙赶往车站。

ex.en: Local authorities should station trained staff at busy transport hubs to assist passengers with limited mobility.
ex.zh: 地方政府应在繁忙的交通枢纽安排受过培训的工作人员，帮助行动不便的乘客。

tip: 作动词常用被动式be stationed at，表示被派驻。

senses.en: To remain in a place or live somewhere temporarily.
To continue being in a particular condition.
A period spent living or visiting somewhere.

ex.en: We stayed at a small hotel beside the lake.
ex.zh: 我们住在湖边的一家小旅馆里。

ex.en: Tourists who stay longer in rural areas may contribute more to local businesses than short-term visitors.
ex.zh: 比起短期游客，在乡村停留更久的游客可能为当地商家带来更多收益。

tip: stay后可直接接形容词，如stay calm保持冷静。

senses.en: to take something without permission and keep or use it
to move quietly without attracting attention
something bought for much less than its usual price

ex.en: Someone stole my bicycle while I was buying bread.
ex.zh: 我买面包的时候，有人偷走了我的自行车。

ex.en: Companies must protect customer information because criminals may steal personal data from insecure websites.
ex.zh: 企业必须保护客户信息，因为犯罪分子可能从不安全的网站窃取个人数据。

col: steal from someone｜偷某人的东西
tip: 过去式stole，过去分词stolen；宾语通常是物。

senses.en: the main plant part supporting leaves, flowers, or fruit
originate or result from something
stop or reduce an unwanted flow or increase

ex.en: She cut the rose stem before filling the vase.
ex.zh: 她先修剪了玫瑰的花茎，再给花瓶加水。

ex.en: Many urban transport problems stem from poor planning rather than a simple shortage of road space.
ex.zh: 许多城市交通问题源于规划不善，而不只是道路空间不足。

col: stem the flow of｜遏制…的流动
stem the tide of｜遏制…的势头
tip: “源于”用stem from；大写STEM指理工科。

senses.en: a foot movement when walking, or a stair surface
one action in a process or towards a goal
to move by lifting and placing your foot

ex.en: Take one step forward and close the door.
ex.zh: 向前迈一步，把门关上。

ex.en: Improving public transport is an important step towards reducing traffic congestion and air pollution in cities.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通是减少城市交通拥堵和空气污染的重要一步。

col: take a step｜迈一步；采取措施
tip: take steps to do sth表示“采取措施做某事”。

senses.en: A long, thin piece of wood used for various purposes.
To attach something, or become attached, using a sticky substance.
To push a pointed object into something.

ex.en: The dog brought a stick back to me.
ex.zh: 那只狗把一根树枝叼回给我。

ex.en: Students can stick pictures onto a shared poster to present their research on local wildlife.
ex.zh: 学生可以把图片贴在共同制作的海报上，展示他们对当地野生动物的研究。

col: stick to a plan｜坚持计划
stick a picture on｜把图片贴在……上
tip: 动词过去式和过去分词均为stuck；stick to表示坚持。

senses.en: able to stick to things, often because of a substance
uncomfortably warm and damp
difficult or awkward to deal with

ex.en: My fingers were sticky after eating the honey cake.
ex.zh: 吃完蜂蜜蛋糕后，我的手指黏糊糊的。

ex.en: Food packaging often contains sticky residues that must be removed before the materials can be recycled effectively.
ex.zh: 食品包装上常有黏性残留物，必须先清除才能有效回收材料。

tip: sticky weather指湿热天气；sticky situation指困境。

senses.en: Continuing up to a particular time without stopping or changing.
Not moving.
Despite what has just been said.

ex.en: It is nearly midnight, but my sister is still awake.
ex.zh: 快到午夜了，可我姐姐还醒着。

ex.en: Despite improvements in public transport, many commuters still rely on private cars because services remain unreliable in rural areas.
ex.zh: 尽管公共交通有所改善，许多通勤者仍依赖私家车，因为农村地区的公共交通服务依然不可靠。

tip: 表“仍然”时，通常放实义动词前、be动词后。

senses.en: The organ that digests food, or the surrounding body area
To accept something unpleasant without feeling upset or disgusted

ex.en: My stomach started rumbling while I was cooking dinner.
ex.zh: 我做晚饭时，肚子开始咕咕叫。

ex.en: Eating regular meals may help prevent stomach discomfort and support healthy eating habits among students.
ex.zh: 规律进餐可能有助于预防胃部不适，并帮助学生养成健康的饮食习惯。

tip: 表示“忍受”时，常用于 can't stomach 结构。

senses.en: Hard natural material from the ground, or a piece of it.
A hard mass that forms inside an organ.
The hard central part of some fruits containing the seed.

ex.en: She picked up a smooth stone beside the lake.
ex.zh: 她在湖边捡起了一块光滑的石头。

ex.en: Buildings constructed from local stone can preserve regional character and reduce the environmental costs of transporting materials.
ex.zh: 使用当地石料建造的建筑可以保留地域特色，并降低运输建材带来的环境成本。

tip: 石料用不可数stone；一块石头用a stone。

senses.en: a place where people buy goods
to keep something somewhere for future use
a supply of something kept for future use

ex.en: The store near our house sells fresh bread.
ex.zh: 我们家附近的商店卖新鲜面包。

ex.en: Modern batteries can store energy from solar panels for use when sunlight is no longer available.
ex.zh: 现代电池可以储存太阳能板产生的能量，以便在没有阳光时使用。

col: a store of knowledge｜知识储备
tip: 商店在美式中常用store，英式日常更常用shop。

senses.en: severe weather with strong winds and rain, snow, or thunder
to move somewhere angrily and forcefully
a sudden wave of strong public anger or criticism

ex.en: We stayed indoors while the storm shook the windows.
ex.zh: 暴风雨震得窗户直响，我们一直待在屋里。

ex.en: Coastal communities need stronger flood defences to protect homes and essential services during severe storms.
ex.zh: 沿海社区需要更坚固的防洪设施，以在强风暴期间保护住房和基本公共服务。

col: a storm of protest｜抗议浪潮
storm out of the room｜怒气冲冲地走出房间
tip: storm out表示愤然离开，不是风暴向外移动。

senses.en: Having strong winds and often heavy rain, thunder, or lightning.
Involving strong emotions, arguments, or disagreement.

ex.en: We stayed indoors because the weather was so stormy.
ex.zh: 因为外面风雨交加，我们待在了室内。

ex.en: Increasingly stormy conditions may disrupt shipping routes and threaten the livelihoods of people in coastal communities.
ex.zh: 日益频繁的暴风雨天气可能扰乱航运路线，并威胁沿海社区居民的生计。

col: a stormy relationship｜争吵不断的关系
tip: 既可形容天气，也可形容关系或讨论充满冲突。

senses.en: an account of real or imagined events
a report about an event in the news
one level of a building, in American English

ex.en: Grandma told us a funny story about her childhood.
ex.zh: 奶奶给我们讲了一个她童年的趣事。

ex.en: Sharing a personal story can help students understand historical events from a more human perspective.
ex.zh: 分享个人经历可以帮助学生从更有人情味的角度理解历史事件。

tip: 楼层英式写storey，美式写story；高度不固定。

senses.en: not curved or bent
directly, without turning or stopping
honest and clear rather than hiding the truth

ex.en: Use a ruler to draw a straight line.
ex.zh: 用尺子画一条直线。

ex.en: Building straight roads across mountainous regions can be expensive and may damage natural habitats.
ex.zh: 在山区修建笔直的道路可能成本高昂，还可能破坏自然栖息地。

col: a straight answer｜直截了当的回答
tip: straight本身可作副词，不用加-ly。

senses.en: easy to understand or do, without complications
honest and direct in expressing thoughts or intentions

ex.en: The recipe is straightforward, even for a beginner.
ex.zh: 这道食谱很简单，即使初学者也能照着做。

ex.en: Governments should make recycling procedures straightforward so that more households can participate without unnecessary confusion.
ex.zh: 政府应简化回收流程，让更多家庭能够参与，避免不必要的困惑。

col: a straightforward answer｜直截了当的回答
tip: 既可形容事情简单，也可形容人坦率。

senses.en: Unusual or unexpected in a way that seems surprising
Not known or experienced before

ex.en: There was a strange noise coming from the cupboard.
ex.zh: 橱柜里传出一阵奇怪的声音。

ex.en: Customs that seem strange to visitors may reflect important social values within the local community.
ex.zh: 在游客看来奇怪的习俗，可能体现了当地社区重要的社会价值观。

tip: strange 可指奇怪，也可指陌生；stranger 是陌生人。

senses.en: someone you do not know
someone unfamiliar with a particular place or community

ex.en: A kind stranger helped me carry my heavy suitcase.
ex.zh: 一位好心的陌生人帮我提了沉重的行李箱。

ex.en: Community events can encourage residents to interact with strangers and develop a stronger sense of belonging.
ex.zh: 社区活动可以鼓励居民与陌生人交流，增强归属感。

col: stranger to the area｜初到这一地区的人
tip: stranger是陌生人，不等于foreigner外国人。

senses.en: a planned approach for achieving a particular goal

ex.en: Our strategy was to save a little every week.
ex.zh: 我们的策略是每周存一点钱。

ex.en: An effective transport strategy should improve public services while reducing dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 有效的交通策略应在改善公共服务的同时减少对私家车的依赖。

col: a strategy for growth｜增长策略
tip: 常用a strategy for doing sth表示做某事的策略。

senses.en: a soft red fruit with tiny seeds on its surface

ex.en: I picked a ripe strawberry and put it in my basket.
ex.zh: 我摘了一颗熟透的草莓，放进篮子里。

ex.en: Growing strawberries locally can reduce transport distances, although heated greenhouses may increase overall energy consumption.
ex.zh: 在本地种植草莓可以缩短运输距离，但加温温室可能增加总体能源消耗。

tip: 可数名词，复数为strawberries。

senses.en: Physical power to lift, move, or resist something.
A quality or skill that makes someone or something effective.
How strong, powerful, or resistant to damage something is.

ex.en: I needed all my strength to lift the suitcase.
ex.zh: 我使出全身力气才提起那个手提箱。

ex.en: Schools should help students identify their strengths rather than judge everyone solely through written examinations.
ex.zh: 学校应帮助学生发现自己的长处，而不是仅凭笔试评判所有人。

tip: 表示力气通常不可数；表示长处可数。

senses.en: Mental strain caused by difficult situations or too many demands
To give particular importance to something when speaking or writing
Extra force used when pronouncing a syllable or word

ex.en: A short walk helps me deal with work stress.
ex.zh: 散一小会儿步有助于我缓解工作压力。

ex.en: Schools should teach students practical strategies for managing stress during examinations and other demanding periods.
ex.zh: 学校应教给学生实用的方法，帮助他们应对考试及其他紧张时期的压力。

col: stress the importance of｜强调…的重要性
tip: 人感到压力用stressed；事情令人紧张用stressful。

senses.en: requiring rules to be obeyed and standards to be met
following an exact meaning or limit without exceptions

ex.en: Our coach is strict about arriving on time.
ex.zh: 我们的教练对准时到场要求很严格。

ex.en: Strict environmental regulations can encourage manufacturers to adopt cleaner technologies and reduce harmful industrial emissions.
ex.zh: 严格的环境法规可以促使制造商采用更清洁的技术，减少有害工业排放。

col: strict about punctuality｜严格要求守时
in the strict sense｜严格意义上
tip: 对人严格用with；对事情要求严格用about。

senses.en: Sudden brain damage caused by interrupted blood flow or bleeding.
One complete movement of a limb, tool, or brush.
To move your hand gently over a surface repeatedly.

ex.en: The cat purred while I stroked its soft fur.
ex.zh: 我轻抚猫咪柔软的毛，它发出了呼噜声。

ex.en: Recognising the early symptoms of a stroke can help patients receive treatment before serious brain damage occurs.
ex.zh: 识别中风的早期症状，有助于患者在出现严重脑损伤前接受治疗。

col: a swimming stroke｜游泳划水动作
tip: 中风用have a stroke，勿与心脏病发作混淆。

senses.en: having great physical power or force
not easily broken or damaged
great in intensity, influence, or convincing power

ex.en: My brother is strong enough to lift this sofa.
ex.zh: 我哥哥力气很大，能抬起这张沙发。

ex.en: There is strong evidence that regular physical activity improves both mental health and academic performance.
ex.zh: 有充分证据表明，规律的体育活动能改善心理健康并提高学业表现。

tip: strong at表示擅长；strong通常是形容词。

senses.en: a person who studies at a school, college, or university

ex.en: A student left her backpack under the library desk.
ex.zh: 一名学生把背包落在了图书馆的书桌下面。

ex.en: Universities should ensure that every student can access affordable housing and appropriate support throughout their studies.
ex.zh: 大学应确保每位学生在整个求学期间都能获得负担得起的住宿及适当支持。

tip: student不限于大学生；pupil主要指中小学生。

senses.en: Spend time learning about or carefully examining a subject.
The activity of learning, or an investigation of a subject.
A room used for reading, writing, or working.

ex.en: I study English on the bus every morning.
ex.zh: 我每天早上在公交车上学英语。

ex.en: A recent study suggests that regular exercise can improve students' concentration during classroom activities.
ex.zh: 最近一项研究表明，经常锻炼能提高学生在课堂活动中的专注力。

col: a recent study｜最近的一项研究
study for an exam｜为考试学习
tip: study强调学习过程，learn常强调学会或获得知识。

senses.en: A distinctive way of doing something or expressing ideas.
The design of something or a fashionable appearance.
To arrange or design something to achieve a particular look.

ex.en: Her colourful paintings have a cheerful, playful style.
ex.zh: 她色彩丰富的画作有一种欢快、俏皮的风格。

ex.en: Modern architects often adapt traditional building styles to preserve local identity while meeting contemporary housing needs.
ex.zh: 现代建筑师常改良传统建筑风格，在满足当代住房需求的同时保留地方特色。

col: style your hair｜给头发做造型
tip: style可指个人风格，不一定表示流行时尚。

senses.en: Something discussed, studied, or taught.
Affected by something or dependent on a condition.
To make someone experience something, especially something unpleasant.

ex.en: Science was my favourite subject when I was younger.
ex.zh: 我小时候最喜欢的学科是科学。

ex.en: Schools should give creative subjects sufficient attention because they help students develop imagination and problem-solving skills.
ex.zh: 学校应给予创意类学科充分重视，因为这些学科有助于培养学生的想象力和解决问题的能力。

col: subject someone to stress｜使某人承受压力
tip: 动词重音在后：/səbˈdʒekt/；常用subject A to B。

senses.en: An urban railway system that runs mainly underground.
A passage allowing people to walk beneath a road.

ex.en: We took the subway to the museum this morning.
ex.zh: 今天上午我们乘地铁去了博物馆。

ex.en: Expanding subway networks can ease traffic congestion, provided that services remain affordable and accessible to local residents.
ex.zh: 扩建地铁网络可以缓解交通拥堵，前提是当地居民能够负担票价并方便地使用服务。

tip: 美式指地铁；英式常指地下人行通道。

senses.en: To achieve what you are trying to do.
To take someone's position after they leave it.

ex.en: After several attempts, I succeeded in fixing the lamp.
ex.zh: 尝试了几次后，我终于把灯修好了。

ex.en: Students are more likely to succeed when schools provide consistent feedback and practical support.
ex.zh: 学校持续提供反馈和实际支持时，学生更有可能取得成功。

col: succeed in doing something｜成功做成某事
succeed as a manager｜作为经理取得成功
succeed someone as chair｜接替某人担任主席
tip: 表示成功做成某事，用succeed in doing，不用to do。

senses.en: Achieving the result that was wanted or intended.
Having achieved wealth, respect, or a good position.

ex.en: Our first attempt at baking bread was surprisingly successful.
ex.zh: 我们第一次尝试烤面包，出乎意料地成功了。

ex.en: Successful recycling programmes depend on convenient collection facilities and clear guidance for households and businesses.
ex.zh: 成功的回收计划依赖便利的收集设施，以及面向家庭和企业的明确指引。

col: successful in doing something｜成功做成某事
tip: 常用be successful in doing；动词为succeed。

senses.en: of the kind already mentioned or being described
used to emphasise a quality or degree before a noun

ex.en: It was such a lovely day that we ate outside.
ex.zh: 天气如此宜人，我们就在外面吃了饭。

ex.en: Many cities face severe traffic congestion, and such problems require coordinated investment in public transport.
ex.zh: 许多城市面临严重的交通拥堵，这类问题需要统筹公共交通投资来解决。

tip: 单数可数名词前用such a/an；so后直接接形容词。

senses.en: Happening quickly and unexpectedly

ex.en: A sudden gust blew my hat into the pond.
ex.zh: 一阵突如其来的风把我的帽子吹进了池塘。

ex.en: A sudden rise in food prices can place considerable pressure on families with low incomes.
ex.zh: 食品价格突然上涨会给低收入家庭带来相当大的压力。

tip: sudden是形容词；修饰动作通常用suddenly。

senses.en: Quickly and unexpectedly, with little or no warning.

ex.en: The lights suddenly went out while we were cooking.
ex.zh: 我们做饭时，灯突然灭了。

ex.en: When demand suddenly increases, public transport systems may struggle to provide enough services for passengers.
ex.zh: 当需求突然增加时，公共交通系统可能难以为乘客提供足够的班次。

tip: 可置于句首或动词前；强调变化突然、事先无预兆。

senses.en: To experience physical pain or mental distress.
To experience something harmful or become worse.

ex.en: I suffer from headaches when I skip lunch.
ex.zh: 我不吃午饭时就会头痛。

ex.en: Small businesses often suffer financial losses when major roadworks prevent customers from reaching their premises.
ex.zh: 大型道路施工导致顾客无法到店时，小企业往往会遭受经济损失。

tip: 疾病常用suffer from；损失、损坏常直接接在suffer后。

senses.en: A sweet substance used to make food and drinks sweeter

ex.en: She stirred a spoonful of sugar into her tea.
ex.zh: 她往茶里加了一勺糖，搅拌均匀。

ex.en: Reducing sugar consumption can help prevent health problems associated with an unhealthy diet.
ex.zh: 减少糖的摄入有助于预防与不健康饮食有关的健康问题。

tip: 泛指食糖时通常不可数；a spoonful of sugar指一勺糖。

senses.en: To offer an idea or possible action for consideration.
To indicate that something may be true.

ex.en: I suggest taking an umbrella because those clouds look dark.
ex.zh: 我建议带把伞，因为那些云看起来很阴沉。

ex.en: Recent studies suggest that access to green spaces can improve mental health among urban residents.
ex.zh: 近期研究表明，能够接触绿地可能有助于改善城市居民的心理健康。

col: suggest a solution｜提出解决方案
tip: 用suggest doing或suggest that从句，不用suggest to do。

senses.en: an idea offered for someone to consider
a slight sign that something exists or may be true

ex.en: Your suggestion to bring a picnic was really helpful.
ex.zh: 你提议带上野餐食物，真是帮了大忙。

ex.en: The suggestion to expand cycle lanes received strong support from residents concerned about road safety.
ex.zh: 扩建自行车道的建议得到了关注道路安全的居民的大力支持。

tip: suggestion是可数名词；advice通常不可数。

senses.en: to be convenient or right for someone
to make someone look attractive
matching clothes consisting of a jacket and trousers or skirt

ex.en: Would an earlier appointment suit you better tomorrow?
ex.zh: 明天把预约时间提前一点会更适合你吗？

ex.en: Flexible working hours suit employees who need to balance professional responsibilities with family commitments.
ex.zh: 弹性工作时间适合需要兼顾工作职责与家庭责任的员工。

col: suit your needs｜满足你的需求
tip: suit强调合适或好看；fit强调尺寸合身。

senses.en: right for a particular person, purpose, or situation

ex.en: These walking shoes are suitable for muddy forest paths.
ex.zh: 这双步行鞋适合走泥泞的林间小路。

ex.en: Cities should provide suitable housing for older residents, with easy access to healthcare and public transport.
ex.zh: 城市应为老年居民提供合适的住房，方便他们就医和乘坐公共交通。

col: a suitable candidate｜合适的候选人
tip: 常用suitable for sb/sth或suitable to do sth。

senses.en: to state the main points briefly

ex.en: Could you summarize the story before we discuss it?
ex.zh: 我们讨论之前，你能概括一下这个故事吗？

ex.en: Students should learn to summarize research findings accurately rather than reproduce every detail from their sources.
ex.zh: 学生应学会准确概括研究结果，而不是复述资料中的每个细节。

col: summarize the findings｜概括研究结果
summarize the main points｜总结要点
tip: 英式也常拼作summarise；总结时保留要点。

senses.en: The warmest season, between spring and autumn.

ex.en: We often eat outside during the long summer evenings.
ex.zh: 夏天傍晚很长，我们常在户外吃饭。

ex.en: Rising summer temperatures may increase demand for electricity as more households rely on air conditioning.
ex.zh: 夏季气温上升可能使更多家庭依赖空调，从而增加电力需求。

tip: 泛指夏季可用in summer；季节名称通常小写。

senses.en: The star that gives Earth light and heat.
The light and warmth coming from the sun.
Sit or lie where sunlight warms your body.

ex.en: The sun appeared just as we reached the beach.
ex.zh: 我们刚到海滩，太阳就出来了。

ex.en: Energy from the sun can provide a renewable alternative to fossil fuels in regions with suitable conditions.
ex.zh: 在条件适宜的地区，太阳能可以成为化石燃料的可再生替代能源。

tip: 指太阳通常用the sun；in the sun表示在阳光下。

senses.en: the day after Saturday and before Monday

ex.en: We usually cook a big lunch together on Sunday.
ex.zh: 我们通常在星期日一起做一顿丰盛的午餐。

ex.en: Opening public libraries on Sunday allows people with busy weekday schedules to access essential community services.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆星期日开放，让工作日忙碌的人也能享用重要的社区服务。

tip: 星期名称首字母大写；on Sunday，但next Sunday不用on。

senses.en: glasses with dark lenses that protect eyes from bright sunlight

ex.en: I put on my sunglasses before leaving the house.
ex.zh: 出门前，我戴上了太阳镜。

ex.en: Wearing sunglasses with adequate ultraviolet protection can reduce the risk of eye damage during outdoor activities.
ex.zh: 在户外活动时，佩戴具有充分紫外线防护功能的太阳镜可以降低眼睛受损的风险。

col: a pair of sunglasses｜一副太阳镜
tip: 通常用复数；一副说a pair of sunglasses。

senses.en: the natural light that comes from the sun

ex.en: Warm sunlight streamed through the window onto my desk.
ex.zh: 温暖的阳光透过窗户洒在我的书桌上。

ex.en: Designing classrooms to receive more natural sunlight may improve students' comfort and reduce electricity use.
ex.zh: 让教室获得更多自然光的设计可能提高学生的舒适度，并减少用电。

tip: 不可数名词；in direct sunlight表示在阳光直射下。

senses.en: having plenty of bright sunlight
cheerful and positive in character or mood

ex.en: We ate breakfast on the sunny balcony this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上，我们在阳光充足的阳台上吃了早餐。

ex.en: Regions with sunny climates can generate substantial amounts of electricity through well-planned solar energy projects.
ex.zh: 阳光充足的地区可以通过规划合理的太阳能项目产生大量电力。

tip: sunny强调阳光足，不一定表示气温高。

senses.en: The appearance of the sun above the horizon each morning.

ex.en: We woke early to watch the sunrise over the lake.
ex.zh: 我们早早醒来，观看湖上的日出。

ex.en: Outdoor activities scheduled around sunrise allow tourists to enjoy cooler temperatures and observe local wildlife.
ex.zh: 安排在日出前后的户外活动让游客能在较凉爽的气温下观赏当地野生动物。

tip: 在日出时用at sunrise；日落是sunset。

senses.en: the time when the sun disappears below the horizon
the colourful sky seen as the sun goes down

ex.en: We reached the beach just before sunset yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我们在日落前刚好赶到了海滩。

ex.en: Coastal destinations often attract tourists with spectacular sunset views, creating valuable opportunities for local businesses.
ex.zh: 沿海目的地常以壮丽的落日景色吸引游客，为当地企业创造宝贵商机。

col: a spectacular sunset｜壮丽的落日景象
tip: 表示在日落时用at sunset，通常不加冠词。

senses.en: light and warmth coming from the sun

senses.zh: 欢乐；带来快乐的人或事
senses.en: happiness, or someone or something that brings happiness

ex.en: We ate our breakfast outside in the warm sunshine.
ex.zh: 我们在外面温暖的阳光下吃了早餐。

ex.en: Access to parks and sunshine can improve residents' wellbeing, especially in densely populated urban areas.
ex.zh: 能够享用公园和阳光可以改善居民的身心健康，在人口密集的城市地区尤其如此。

col: a ray of sunshine｜带来快乐的人或事
tip: sunshine通常不可数；表示晴天可说a sunny day。

senses.en: Extremely good or enjoyable, used informally.
Very or extremely, used informally before adjectives or adverbs.

ex.en: We had a super afternoon playing games in the garden.
ex.zh: 我们在花园里玩游戏，度过了一个特别愉快的下午。

ex.en: Although users may describe an app as super helpful, researchers need objective evidence to assess its educational value.
ex.zh: 尽管用户可能形容某款应用特别有帮助，研究人员仍需客观证据来评估其教育价值。

tip: 口语色彩强；正式写作宜用excellent或very。

senses.en: a large shop selling food and other everyday goods

ex.en: We stopped at the supermarket to buy milk and rice.
ex.zh: 我们顺路去超市买了牛奶和大米。

ex.en: Large supermarkets can offer lower prices, but their expansion may threaten independent shops in smaller communities.
ex.zh: 大型超市能提供更低的价格，但其扩张可能威胁小型社区里的独立商店。

tip: 在超市购物常说shop at a supermarket。

senses.en: to provide something that someone needs
the provision or available amount of something needed
essential items kept or provided for use

ex.en: A nearby farm supplies fresh eggs to our shop.
ex.zh: 附近一家农场给我们的商店供应新鲜鸡蛋。

ex.en: Cities must secure a reliable water supply as population growth and climate change place increasing pressure on resources.
ex.zh: 随着人口增长和气候变化给资源带来越来越大的压力，城市必须确保可靠的供水。

col: supply someone with something｜向某人供应某物
tip: supply A with B＝supply B to A；物资常用supplies。

senses.en: to help, encourage, provide for, or agree with someone
to hold something up or bear its weight
help, encouragement, money, or something that holds another thing up

ex.en: My sister supports me whenever I try something new.
ex.zh: 每当我尝试新事物时，姐姐都会支持我。

ex.en: Governments should provide financial support for small businesses that create jobs in economically disadvantaged communities.
ex.zh: 政府应为在经济困难社区创造就业机会的小企业提供资金支持。

col: support an argument｜为论点提供依据
tip: support是及物动词；名词常用support for。

senses.en: To think something is probably true without being certain.
To imagine a situation in order to consider its consequences.

ex.en: I suppose we can eat outside if it stays warm.
ex.zh: 我想，如果天气一直这么暖和，我们可以在外面吃饭。

ex.en: Suppose every household used less electricity; the combined reduction in demand could significantly benefit the environment.
ex.zh: 假设每户家庭都减少用电，需求的总体下降就可能为环境带来显著益处。

col: be supposed to do｜应该做；按安排做
tip: be supposed to表示应该或按安排做某事。

senses.en: Feeling no doubt that something is true or correct.
Certain to happen or do something.
Used informally to agree or strongly confirm something.

ex.en: Are you sure you left your keys here?
ex.zh: 你确定把钥匙落在这里了吗？

ex.en: Governments must make sure that rural communities have reliable access to essential healthcare services.
ex.zh: 政府必须确保农村社区能够稳定地获得基本医疗服务。

tip: be sure of表确信；be sure to可表必然或叮嘱。

senses.en: Used when expecting others to agree that something is true
Certainly, or in a way that will achieve a result

ex.en: Surely you can spare five minutes to help?
ex.zh: 你总能抽出五分钟来帮忙吧？

ex.en: Surely governments should prioritise clean drinking water before investing public money in expensive sports facilities.
ex.zh: 政府在投入公共资金建设昂贵的体育设施之前，总该优先保障清洁饮用水吧。

col: slowly but surely｜缓慢而稳步地
will surely lead to｜必将导致
tip: 是副词；句首常表示期待对方赞同。

senses.en: The outside or top layer of something
To rise to the top of water
To become known or noticeable after being hidden

ex.en: Wipe the kitchen surface before you start preparing lunch.
ex.zh: 开始准备午饭前，先擦一下厨房台面。

ex.en: Dark road surfaces absorb heat during the day, contributing to higher temperatures in urban areas.
ex.zh: 深色路面白天吸收热量，导致城市地区气温升高。

tip: on the surface 指“在表面上”，也可指“表面看来”。

senses.en: An unexpected event, or the feeling it causes.
To make someone feel amazed by something unexpected.

ex.en: Finding a birthday cake in the kitchen was a lovely surprise.
ex.zh: 在厨房里发现一个生日蛋糕，真是个美好的惊喜。

ex.en: The survey results may surprise policymakers who assume that young people prefer online learning.
ex.zh: 调查结果可能让那些认为年轻人偏爱线上学习的政策制定者感到意外。

col: to someone's surprise｜令某人惊讶的是
take someone by surprise｜使某人措手不及
tip: 人感到惊讶用surprised；事物令人惊讶用surprising。

senses.en: Feeling that something unexpected has happened.

ex.en: I was surprised to find flowers outside my door.
ex.zh: 发现门外放着鲜花，我很惊讶。

ex.en: Researchers were surprised by how strongly access to green spaces influenced residents' reported levels of wellbeing.
ex.zh: 绿地的可及性对居民自报幸福感的影响如此之大，令研究人员感到惊讶。

col: surprised at the result｜对结果感到惊讶
surprised to hear｜听到后感到意外
tip: surprised形容人的感受；surprising形容事物令人惊讶。

senses.en: A study that collects information by asking people questions.
Collect information by asking people questions.
Examine and measure land or buildings in detail.

ex.en: I completed a short survey about our local library.
ex.zh: 我填写了一份关于本地图书馆的简短问卷。

ex.en: A recent survey suggests that many commuters would cycle more often if safer routes were available.
ex.zh: 最近一项调查表明，如果有更安全的路线，许多通勤者会更经常骑自行车。

tip: 名词重音在首音节，动词重音在末音节。

senses.en: stay alive despite danger, illness, or hardship
continue to exist after difficulties or changes
live longer than another person

ex.en: Our little cactus survived three weeks without water.
ex.zh: 我们的小仙人掌三个星期没浇水也活下来了。

ex.en: Small businesses are more likely to survive economic downturns when they maintain strong relationships with local customers.
ex.zh: 小企业若与本地顾客保持牢固联系，就更有可能挺过经济低迷期。

col: survive an accident｜在事故中幸存
tip: 表示从事故中幸存，直接说survive an accident。

ex.en: We tried sushi at a Japanese restaurant.
ex.zh: 我们在一家日本餐馆品尝了寿司。

ex.en: This sushi is made with rice and vegetables.
ex.zh: 这种寿司是用米饭和蔬菜做的。

col: a plate of sushi｜一盘寿司
tip: 小学教材补充词：先听发音，再结合例句理解，最后用这个词说一句自己的话。
note: 依据小学教材词表整理；释义、例句与插画为本站补充内容，不属于词光官方原词条。

senses.en: A large waterbird with a long neck, usually white

ex.en: A white swan glided silently across the lake.
ex.zh: 一只白天鹅悄无声息地游过湖面。

ex.en: Protecting wetland habitats benefits swan populations while also preserving the wider ecosystems on which many other species depend.
ex.zh: 保护湿地栖息地有益于天鹅种群，同时也能保护许多其他物种赖以生存的更广泛生态系统。

col: a pair of swans｜一对天鹅
tip: 可数名词，复数swans；幼天鹅称cygnet。

senses.en: A knitted garment worn over the upper body for warmth.

ex.en: I pulled on a warm sweater before going outside.
ex.zh: 出门前，我套上了一件暖和的毛衣。

ex.en: Choosing a durable wool sweater rather than several cheap alternatives can reduce clothing waste over time.
ex.zh: 选择一件耐穿的羊毛衫，而不是多件廉价替代品，长远来看可以减少衣物浪费。

tip: 英式英语也常用jumper；sweatshirt指运动衫。

senses.en: to clean a surface using a brush or broom
to move quickly and powerfully across an area

ex.en: Please sweep the kitchen floor before our guests arrive.
ex.zh: 请在客人到来前把厨房地板扫干净。

ex.en: Severe storms can sweep across coastal regions, damaging homes and disrupting essential transport services.
ex.zh: 猛烈的风暴可能席卷沿海地区，损坏房屋并扰乱重要的交通服务。

tip: 过去式、过去分词均为 swept。

senses.en: Having a taste like sugar or honey.
Kind, gentle, or thoughtful.
A small piece of sugary food eaten as a treat.

ex.en: These strawberries are sweet enough to eat without sugar.
ex.zh: 这些草莓已经够甜了，不加糖也好吃。

ex.en: Reducing children's consumption of sweet drinks may lower their risk of tooth decay and excessive weight gain.
ex.zh: 减少儿童含糖饮料的摄入，可能降低他们蛀牙和体重过度增长的风险。

tip: 糖果英式常用sweets，美式常用candy。

senses.en: To move through water using your body.
An occasion when you move through water for exercise or pleasure.

ex.en: We swim in the indoor pool every Saturday morning.
ex.zh: 我们每周六早上都在室内泳池游泳。

ex.en: Schools should teach children to swim because this essential skill improves both physical fitness and water safety.
ex.zh: 学校应教孩子游泳，因为这项基本技能既能增强体能，又能提高水上安全性。

tip: 不规则变化：swim—swam—swum。

ex.en: Sydney is a large city in Australia.
ex.zh: 悉尼是澳大利亚的一座大城市。

ex.en: We saw the Opera House in Sydney.
ex.zh: 我们在悉尼看到了歌剧院。

tip: 小学教材补充词：先听发音，再结合例句理解，最后用这个词说一句自己的话。
note: 依据小学教材词表整理；释义、例句与插画为本站补充内容，不属于词光官方原词条。

senses.en: Something that represents an idea, quality, or group.
A written mark used to represent information.

ex.en: For my grandparents, this old house is a symbol of hope.
ex.zh: 对我的祖父母来说，这座老房子是希望的象征。

ex.en: Public parks can become a symbol of a city's commitment to environmental protection and residents' quality of life.
ex.zh: 公共公园可以成为城市致力于环境保护和提升居民生活质量的象征。

col: a symbol of peace｜和平的象征
a status symbol｜身份地位的象征
tip: “……的象征”用 a symbol of，不用 symbol for。

senses.en: A set of connected parts that work together.
An organised structure through which services or institutions operate.
An organised way of doing something.

ex.en: The heating system stopped working during a cold night.
ex.zh: 在一个寒冷的夜晚，供暖系统停止了运行。

ex.en: An effective education system should support students with different abilities and prepare them for future employment.
ex.zh: 有效的教育体系应支持能力各异的学生，并帮助他们为未来就业做好准备。

col: public transport system｜公共交通系统
tip: systematic指有条理的，systemic指全系统的。

senses.en: A casual shirt, usually with short sleeves and no collar.

ex.en: I packed a clean T-shirt for the picnic.
ex.zh: 我为野餐带了一件干净的T恤衫。

ex.en: Choosing a durable cotton T-shirt instead of disposable fashion can reduce waste and encourage more responsible consumption.
ex.zh: 选择耐穿的棉质T恤衫而非一次性时尚服饰，可以减少浪费并促进更负责任的消费。

tip: 可数名词，复数为 T-shirts，保留连字符。

ex.en: The taikonaut worked inside China's space station.
ex.zh: 这名中国航天员在中国空间站内工作。

ex.en: Many children dream of becoming a taikonaut.
ex.zh: 许多孩子梦想成为中国航天员。

col: a Chinese taikonaut｜一名中国航天员
become a taikonaut｜成为中国航天员
tip: 小学教材补充词：先听发音，再结合例句理解，最后用这个词说一句自己的话。
note: 依据小学教材词表整理；释义、例句与插画为本站补充内容，不属于词光官方原词条。

senses.en: the rear part of an animal or an aircraft
to follow someone closely and watch where they go

ex.en: The dog wagged its tail when I came home.
ex.zh: 我回家时，那只狗摇起了尾巴。

ex.en: Some animals use their tails for balance, which helps them move safely through complex forest habitats.
ex.zh: 一些动物用尾巴保持平衡，这有助于它们在复杂的森林栖息地中安全移动。

tip: tail指尾巴；tale指故事，两词同音。

senses.en: To pick up, hold, or carry something away.
To require a particular amount of time or effort.
To use a particular form of transport.

ex.en: Take an umbrella because it might rain this afternoon.
ex.zh: 带把伞吧，今天下午可能会下雨。

ex.en: Developing reliable public transport networks takes considerable time and requires sustained investment from local authorities.
ex.zh: 建设可靠的公共交通网络需要相当长的时间，也需要地方政府持续投入资金。

tip: 过去式took，过去分词taken；take带走，bring带来。

senses.en: A natural ability to do something well.
People who have strong abilities in a particular field.

ex.en: My cousin has a real talent for drawing animals.
ex.zh: 我的表亲画动物很有天赋。

ex.en: Schools should nurture creative talent alongside academic skills to help students develop a wider range of abilities.
ex.zh: 学校应在培养学业技能的同时培育创造性才能，帮助学生发展更广泛的能力。

col: a talent for｜在某方面的天赋
tip: 表示某方面的天赋，用a talent for加名词或动名词。

senses.en: Having a natural ability to do something very well.

ex.en: My talented cousin painted this beautiful picture of our garden.
ex.zh: 我那位有绘画天赋的表亲画了这幅漂亮的花园图。

ex.en: Schools should provide opportunities for talented students to develop their abilities beyond the standard curriculum.
ex.zh: 学校应为有才华的学生提供机会，让他们在标准课程之外发展自己的能力。

col: a talented musician｜有天赋的音乐家
a talented artist｜有才华的艺术家
tip: talented强调天赋；skilled强调熟练技能。

senses.en: to speak to someone or discuss something
a conversation or discussion between people
a speech given to an audience about a subject

ex.en: We talked about our weekend plans over breakfast.
ex.zh: 我们吃早饭时聊了聊周末的计划。

ex.en: Schools should encourage students to talk openly about stress and seek support when they need it.
ex.zh: 学校应鼓励学生坦诚谈论压力，并在需要时寻求帮助。

tip: talk about接话题；talk to或with接人。

senses.en: having greater than average height

ex.en: A tall tree shades our garden in the afternoon.
ex.zh: 下午，一棵高大的树为我们的花园遮阴。

ex.en: Tall buildings can accommodate more residents, but careful planning is needed to preserve sunlight and public space.
ex.zh: 高层建筑可以容纳更多居民，但需要精心规划，以保留阳光和公共空间。

tip: 人、树、楼通常用tall；山通常用high。

senses.en: a device that controls water flowing from a pipe
to touch or hit something lightly
to use an available source of energy, knowledge, or resources

ex.en: Please turn off the tap while brushing your teeth.
ex.zh: 刷牙时请关上水龙头。

ex.en: Universities can tap local expertise to develop practical solutions to environmental problems affecting nearby communities.
ex.zh: 大学可以利用当地的专业知识，为影响周边社区的环境问题制定切实可行的解决方案。

col: turn off the tap｜关上水龙头
tap someone on the shoulder｜轻拍某人的肩膀
tip: 水龙头在美式英语中常称faucet。

senses.en: A narrow sticky strip used to attach or seal things.
A magnetic strip used to record sound, images, or data.
Attach or secure something using sticky tape.

ex.en: I sealed the parcel with a strip of tape.
ex.zh: 我用一条胶带封好了包裹。

ex.en: Older interviews stored on magnetic tape should be digitised to preserve valuable records for future historical research.
ex.zh: 保存在磁带上的早期访谈应进行数字化处理，为未来的历史研究保存珍贵记录。

col: a roll of tape｜一卷胶带
tip: 胶带通常不可数；一卷胶带说a roll of tape。

senses.en: A piece of work that needs to be done.
Give someone responsibility for a particular piece of work.

ex.en: My first task today is to water the plants.
ex.zh: 我今天的第一项任务是给植物浇水。

ex.en: Dividing a complex task into smaller stages can help students manage their time more effectively.
ex.zh: 把复杂任务分成较小的阶段，可以帮助学生更有效地管理时间。

col: a challenging task｜有挑战性的任务
task someone with doing something｜指派某人做某事
tip: 作动词用task sb with doing sth，表示指派任务。

senses.en: A food's flavour, or the sense that detects it.
To try food or drink, or have a particular flavour.
Someone's preferences or ability to judge what is attractive.

ex.en: The soup has a rich taste of roasted tomatoes.
ex.zh: 这汤有浓郁的烤番茄味。

ex.en: Children may develop a taste for healthier foods when schools offer varied and appealing meals.
ex.zh: 学校提供多样且诱人的餐食，可能会让孩子逐渐喜欢上更健康的食物。

tip: taste表示“尝起来”时接形容词，不接副词。

senses.en: a drink made by putting tea leaves in hot water
dried leaves used to make tea
a light afternoon meal or, in Britain, an early evening meal

ex.en: I made a pot of tea while you rested.
ex.zh: 你休息的时候，我泡了一壶茶。

ex.en: In many cultures, sharing tea provides an opportunity for conversation and strengthens relationships between generations.
ex.zh: 在许多文化中，一起喝茶为交谈提供了机会，也增进了代际关系。

tip: 茶水通常不可数；点单时two teas指两杯茶。

senses.en: Help someone learn knowledge, skills, or ways of behaving

ex.en: My aunt taught me how to mend a shirt.
ex.zh: 姑姑教会了我如何缝补衬衫。

ex.en: Schools should teach children how to evaluate online information rather than simply memorise facts.
ex.zh: 学校应教孩子如何评估网上的信息，而非只是死记事实。

col: teach a subject｜教授一门学科
teach someone to swim｜教某人游泳
teach a lesson｜授课；给以教训
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为taught；教某人做用teach sb to do。

senses.en: someone whose job is to help people learn

ex.en: Our teacher brought a plant into class today.
ex.zh: 我们的老师今天带了一株植物来上课。

ex.en: A well-trained teacher can adapt classroom activities to support students with different learning needs and abilities.
ex.zh: 训练有素的教师能够调整课堂活动，以帮助学习需求和能力各不相同的学生。

tip: 英语中称呼老师通常用Mr、Ms等加姓，不直接喊Teacher。

senses.en: a group working together or playing a sport together
to join someone to work together, usually with up

ex.en: Our team celebrated with pizza after winning the match.
ex.zh: 我们队赢得比赛后，吃披萨庆祝了一番。

ex.en: Working in a team helps students develop communication skills that are essential for future employment.
ex.zh: 团队合作有助于学生培养未来就业所必需的沟通能力。

tip: 英式英语中team可接单数或复数谓语。

senses.en: People working together effectively to achieve a shared goal

ex.en: Good teamwork helped us finish painting before lunch.
ex.zh: 良好的团队合作让我们在午饭前刷完了漆。

ex.en: Group projects can develop teamwork skills that students will need in their future careers.
ex.zh: 小组项目可以培养学生未来工作所需的团队合作能力。

tip: 不可数名词；强调团队成员共同协作。

senses.en: To pull something apart or make a hole by pulling.
A drop of liquid that comes from your eye.
A hole or split caused by pulling something apart.

ex.en: Be careful not to tear the paper bag.
ex.zh: 小心别把纸袋撕破了。

ex.en: Thin plastic bags tear easily, making them less suitable for repeated use than durable cloth alternatives.
ex.zh: 薄塑料袋容易撕裂，因此不如耐用的布袋适合反复使用。

tip: 撕裂读/teə/，眼泪读/tɪə/；动词变化为 tore、torn。

senses.en: A particular way of doing something, often requiring skill.
The skill someone shows when performing a particular activity.

ex.en: The coach showed me a better technique for swimming.
ex.zh: 教练向我示范了一种更好的游泳技巧。

ex.en: Teachers can use a range of assessment techniques to identify learning difficulties before students fall behind.
ex.zh: 教师可以运用多种评估方法，在学生落后之前发现他们的学习困难。

col: a technique for doing something｜做某事的方法
tip: technique重在具体方法；technology指科技。

senses.en: Practical use of scientific knowledge, especially through tools and machines.

ex.en: New technology lets us control the lights from our phones.
ex.zh: 新技术让我们可以用手机控制灯光。

ex.en: Investment in clean technology can reduce industrial pollution while creating skilled jobs in emerging sectors.
ex.zh: 投资清洁技术可以减少工业污染，同时在新兴领域创造技术岗位。

tip: 泛指科技时不可数；多种具体技术可用technologies。

senses.en: A person aged thirteen to nineteen.

ex.en: As a teenager, I cycled to school every day.
ex.zh: 我十几岁时每天骑自行车上学。

ex.en: Schools should provide spaces where teenagers can discuss their concerns and receive support from trained staff.
ex.zh: 学校应提供场所，让青少年能够讨论自己的困扰，并获得受过培训的工作人员的支持。

col: a young teenager｜十三四岁的青少年
as a teenager｜在青少年时期
tip: 特指13至19岁的人，不泛指所有未成年人。

senses.en: An instrument that makes distant objects appear closer and clearer
To fit events or activities into a shorter period
To slide overlapping sections into or out of each other

ex.en: We watched the moon through a telescope on the balcony.
ex.zh: 我们在阳台上用望远镜观察月亮。

ex.en: Space telescopes allow scientists to study distant galaxies without interference from the Earth's atmosphere.
ex.zh: 太空望远镜让科学家能够不受地球大气干扰地研究遥远的星系。

col: look through a telescope｜用望远镜观察
telescope something into｜把某事压缩到
tip: 观星常用telescope；双筒望远镜通常叫binoculars。

senses.en: Give someone information or describe something in words.
Instruct someone to do something.
Recognise a difference or know something from available evidence.

ex.en: Please tell me what happened at school today.
ex.zh: 请告诉我今天在学校发生了什么。

ex.en: Schools should tell parents how personal information about their children is collected and stored.
ex.zh: 学校应告知家长，孩子的个人信息是如何被收集和保存的。

col: tell someone to do something｜吩咐某人做某事
tip: tell常直接接人；say接人时通常用to。

senses.en: A tendency to become angry, or an angry mood.
Make something less strong, extreme, or severe.
Treat metal with heat to give it suitable hardness and toughness.

ex.en: He lost his temper when the drawer jammed again.
ex.zh: 抽屉又卡住了，他大发脾气。

ex.en: Governments should temper enthusiasm for new technologies with careful consideration of their potential social consequences.
ex.zh: 政府应认真考虑新技术可能带来的社会后果，避免一味热衷于推广。

col: temper enthusiasm with caution｜以谨慎节制热情
tip: lose your temper 是发脾气；动词常用 temper A with B。

senses.en: A measure of how hot or cold something is.
A body temperature higher than normal because of illness.

ex.en: The temperature dropped sharply after the sun went down.
ex.zh: 太阳落山后，气温急剧下降。

ex.en: Rising ocean temperatures can damage coral reefs and threaten the survival of many marine species.
ex.zh: 海洋温度上升会破坏珊瑚礁，并威胁许多海洋物种的生存。

col: take someone's temperature｜测量某人的体温
tip: have a temperature通常指发烧，不只是有体温。

ex.en: We need ten pencils for the activity.
ex.zh: 这项活动需要十支铅笔。

ex.en: It takes ten minutes to walk there.
ex.zh: 步行到那里需要十分钟。

tip: 小学教材补充词：先听发音，再结合例句理解，最后用这个词说一句自己的话。
note: 依据小学教材词表整理；释义、例句与插画为本站补充内容，不属于词光官方原词条。

senses.en: a sport involving hitting a ball over a net with rackets

ex.en: We play tennis at the park on Sundays.
ex.zh: 我们每逢周日都在公园打网球。

ex.en: Providing affordable tennis lessons can encourage young people to exercise regularly and develop greater physical coordination.
ex.zh: 提供价格实惠的网球课程，可以鼓励年轻人经常锻炼并提高身体协调能力。

tip: 说 play tennis，不加冠词；球拍用 racket。

senses.en: a portable fabric shelter supported by poles and ropes

ex.en: We pitched our tent beside a quiet lake.
ex.zh: 我们在一个宁静的湖边搭起帐篷。

ex.en: Visitors who sleep in a tent should follow campsite rules to minimise their impact on local wildlife.
ex.zh: 住帐篷的游客应遵守营地规定，尽量减少对当地野生动物的影响。

col: put up a tent｜搭起帐篷
tip: “搭帐篷”用pitch或put up a tent。

senses.en: A word or expression with a particular meaning.
One of the periods into which a school year is divided.
A fixed period during which something lasts or someone serves.

ex.en: Our teacher explained a scientific term using a simple drawing.
ex.zh: 老师用一幅简单的画解释了一个科学术语。

ex.en: The term sustainability describes meeting present needs without limiting the opportunities available to future generations.
ex.zh: 可持续性这一术语指满足当代需求，同时不限制后代可获得的机会。

col: in the long term｜从长远来看
tip: in terms of意为就…而言；条款义常用复数terms。

senses.en: Very bad or unpleasant.
Causing great fear, suffering, or harm.

ex.en: The soup tasted terrible, so I made a sandwich.
ex.zh: 汤很难喝，于是我做了个三明治。

ex.en: Poor waste management can have terrible consequences for public health, especially in densely populated cities.
ex.zh: 垃圾管理不善可能给公共健康带来严重后果，在人口密集的城市尤其如此。

tip: terrible是形容词；表示“非常”通常用terribly。

senses.en: To a very great degree.
In a very bad or unsuccessful way.

ex.en: I'm terribly sorry I spilled juice on your jacket.
ex.zh: 我把果汁洒在了你的夹克上，实在抱歉。

ex.en: Without reliable public transport, elderly residents may feel terribly isolated in remote rural communities.
ex.zh: 如果没有可靠的公共交通，偏远农村社区的老年居民可能会感到非常孤立。

tip: 常作口语强调词，不一定表示“可怕地”。

senses.en: a procedure that checks knowledge, ability, condition, or performance
to check what someone knows or how something performs

ex.en: I have a spelling test at school tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我明天在学校有拼写测验。

ex.en: Researchers must test new materials under different conditions before recommending their use in public buildings.
ex.zh: 研究人员必须在不同条件下测试新材料，才能建议将其用于公共建筑。

tip: 参加测验用take a test；通过测验用pass a test。

senses.en: Written words, especially the main written content of something.
A short written message sent using a phone.
Send someone a short written message using a phone.

ex.en: The text on this menu is too small.
ex.zh: 这份菜单上的字太小了。

ex.en: Teachers can combine text with images to help students understand complex scientific concepts more easily.
ex.zh: 教师可以将文字与图像结合，帮助学生更轻松地理解复杂的科学概念。

tip: 文字内容通常不可数；一条短信可说a text。

senses.en: A book used to study a particular subject.
Showing exactly how something usually happens or should be done.

ex.en: I left my science textbook on the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 我把科学课本落在厨房桌上了。

ex.en: Digital textbooks can reduce school expenses, although some students find printed materials easier to study.
ex.zh: 电子教材可以降低学校开支，不过一些学生觉得纸质材料更便于学习。

tip: 作形容词时指典型或标准，如textbook example。

senses.en: relating to Thailand, its people, or its language
the main language spoken in Thailand
a person from Thailand

ex.en: We shared a delicious Thai curry for dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭我们一起吃了一道美味的泰式咖喱。

ex.en: Thai cuisine attracts international visitors and provides valuable opportunities for local restaurants and cooking schools.
ex.zh: 泰国菜吸引着国际游客，也为当地餐馆和烹饪学校提供了宝贵的机会。

tip: Thai首字母始终大写；泰国是Thailand。

senses.en: used to introduce the second thing in a comparison
used before a clause expressing the other side of a comparison

ex.en: My new backpack is lighter than my old one.
ex.zh: 我的新背包比旧的轻。

ex.en: Investing in public transport may be more effective than building additional roads in crowded cities.
ex.zh: 在拥挤的城市，投资公共交通可能比增建道路更有效。

tip: than用于比较；then表示“然后”，注意拼写。

senses.en: The expression of gratitude, especially in prayer.
A holiday for expressing gratitude, celebrated in the US and Canada.

ex.en: They held a small thanksgiving ceremony after the harvest.
ex.zh: 收获后，他们举行了一场小型感恩仪式。

ex.en: In some countries, Thanksgiving brings families together and encourages reflection on the importance of community support.
ex.zh: 在一些国家，感恩节让家人团聚，也促使人们思考社区互助的重要性。

col: a prayer of thanksgiving｜感恩祷告
tip: 指节日时首字母大写；泛指感恩时用小写。

senses.en: A building where people watch plays and other live performances.
The activity or art of writing, producing, and performing plays.
A specially equipped room in a hospital where operations happen.

ex.en: We arrived at the theatre just before the play started.
ex.zh: 我们在话剧开演前刚好赶到了剧院。

ex.en: Public funding for theatre can make live performances accessible to audiences who cannot afford expensive tickets.
ex.zh: 对戏剧的公共资助能让买不起高价门票的观众也有机会观看现场演出。

col: go to the theatre｜去剧院看戏
tip: 英式拼写theatre，美式常写theater；英式电影院用cinema。

ex.en: Their classroom is on the second floor.
ex.zh: 他们的教室在二楼。

ex.en: The children put away their books.
ex.zh: 孩子们收好了他们的书。

tip: 小学教材补充词：先听发音，再结合例句理解，最后用这个词说一句自己的话。
note: 依据小学教材词表整理；释义、例句与插画为本站补充内容，不属于词光官方原词条。

senses.en: The one or ones belonging to them

ex.en: Our garden is small, but theirs has several trees.
ex.zh: 我们的花园很小，但他们的花园里有好几棵树。

ex.en: Some families own their homes, while others rent theirs because property prices remain beyond their reach.
ex.zh: 有些家庭拥有自己的住房，另一些则因房价仍超出承受能力而租房居住。

col: a friend of theirs｜他们的一位朋友
ours and theirs｜我们的和他们的
tip: theirs独立使用，后不接名词，也不加撇号。

ex.en: I can see them in the playground.
ex.zh: 我能在操场上看到他们。

ex.en: Please put the books back after you use them.
ex.zh: 用完这些书后请把它们放回去。

tip: 小学教材补充词：先听发音，再结合例句理解，最后用这个词说一句自己的话。
note: 依据小学教材词表整理；释义、例句与插画为本站补充内容，不属于词光官方原词条。

ex.en: Wash your hands, then eat lunch.
ex.zh: 先洗手，然后吃午饭。

ex.en: I lived in a small town back then.
ex.zh: 那时候我住在一个小镇上。

tip: 小学教材补充词：先听发音，再结合例句理解，最后用这个词说一句自己的话。
note: 依据小学教材词表整理；释义、例句与插画为本站补充内容，不属于词光官方原词条。

senses.en: In, at, or towards that place.
Used before a verb to introduce something that exists.

ex.en: Leave your muddy boots there, beside the back door.
ex.zh: 把你沾满泥的靴子放在那儿，就在后门旁边。

ex.en: There are several practical ways for cities to reduce waste without increasing household expenses.
ex.zh: 城市可以采取几种切实可行的办法，在不增加家庭开支的情况下减少垃圾。

tip: there表地点或引出存在句；别与their混淆。

senses.en: as a result of what has just been stated

ex.en: The shop was closed; therefore, we went home empty-handed.
ex.zh: 商店关门了，因此我们空手回了家。

ex.en: Public parks encourage physical activity and social interaction; therefore, cities should invest in maintaining accessible green spaces.
ex.zh: 公共公园有助于促进体育活动和社交互动，因此城市应投入资金维护方便使用的绿地。

tip: 是副词，不能仅用逗号连接两个完整句子。

senses.en: Used before plural nouns for nearby people or things.
Nearby people or things, or ones just mentioned.

ex.en: These strawberries smell lovely, so let's buy a basket.
ex.zh: 这些草莓闻起来很香，我们买一篮吧。

ex.en: These findings suggest that regular outdoor activities can improve children's concentration and emotional health.
ex.zh: 这些研究结果表明，经常参加户外活动可以改善儿童的注意力和情绪健康。

col: in these circumstances｜在这些情况下
tip: these是this的复数，后接复数名词。

senses.en: having a large distance between opposite surfaces
having many things close together or being difficult to see through
flowing slowly rather than easily, like heavy cream

ex.en: She wrapped a thick blanket around her cold shoulders.
ex.zh: 她把一条厚毯子裹在冰冷的肩膀上。

ex.en: Thick layers of insulation can reduce heat loss and lower household energy bills during winter.
ex.zh: 厚厚的隔热层可以减少热量流失，降低冬季家庭能源开支。

tip: 形容液体时指黏稠，不一定表示味道浓。

senses.en: Having little distance between opposite sides or surfaces.
Having little body fat or flesh.
To make or become less dense, thick, or numerous.

ex.en: I wore a thin jacket and felt cold outside.
ex.zh: 我穿了件薄外套，在外面觉得冷。

ex.en: Thin layers of insulation can improve energy efficiency without significantly reducing the usable space inside buildings.
ex.zh: 薄层隔热材料能提高能源效率，同时不会明显减少建筑内部的可用空间。

tip: 形容身材时，thin不一定褒义；slim通常含赞美。

senses.en: an object whose name is unknown or not specified
an action, event, fact, or situation
possessions or equipment, usually referred to in the plural

ex.en: Could you move that heavy thing off my chair?
ex.zh: 你能把那个沉东西从我的椅子上搬走吗？

ex.en: One important thing governments can do is ensure that affordable housing is available near public transport.
ex.zh: 政府可以做的一件重要事情，是确保公共交通附近有可负担的住房。

col: the right thing to do｜正确的做法
first thing in the morning｜早晨第一件事
one thing at a time｜一次一件事
tip: thing很笼统；正式写作尽量换成具体名词。

senses.en: To have an opinion or belief about something.
To use your mind to consider ideas or solve problems.

ex.en: I think this soup needs a little more salt.
ex.zh: 我觉得这汤需要再加一点盐。

ex.en: Some people think that schools should devote more time to practical skills rather than examination preparation.
ex.zh: 一些人认为，学校应将更多时间用于实用技能，而不是备考。

tip: 过去式、过去分词均为thought；认为时通常不用进行时。

senses.en: someone who thinks deeply or develops important ideas

ex.en: My grandfather is a quiet thinker who enjoys difficult questions.
ex.zh: 我爷爷是个沉静、爱思考的人，喜欢琢磨难题。

ex.en: Education should encourage students to become independent thinkers rather than simply accept established ideas without question.
ex.zh: 教育应鼓励学生成为独立思考者，而不是不加质疑地接受既有观点。

col: critical thinker｜善于批判性思考的人
influential thinker｜有影响力的思想家
tip: thinker指人；thinking指思考过程或思维方式。

senses.en: Coming after the second and before the fourth.
One of three equal parts of something.

ex.en: Our flat is on the third floor, beside the lift.
ex.zh: 我们的公寓在三楼，电梯旁边。

ex.en: Approximately one third of the city's residents rely on public transport for their daily commute.
ex.zh: 该市约三分之一的居民依靠公共交通进行日常通勤。

tip: 表示分数：one third；two thirds。

senses.en: feeling that you need or want a drink
having a strong desire for something

ex.en: I felt thirsty after walking home in the sun.
ex.zh: 我顶着太阳走回家后觉得口渴。

ex.en: Children who are thirsty for knowledge benefit from lessons that encourage questions and independent exploration.
ex.zh: 渴求知识的孩子能从鼓励提问和自主探索的课程中受益。

tip: 表示渴望某物用thirsty for，不用thirsty of。

ex.en: There are thirteen books on the shelf.
ex.zh: 书架上有十三本书。

ex.en: He is thirteen years old this year.
ex.zh: 他今年十三岁。

tip: 小学教材补充词：先听发音，再结合例句理解，最后用这个词说一句自己的话。
note: 依据小学教材词表整理；释义、例句与插画为本站补充内容，不属于词光官方原词条。

ex.en: Her birthday is on the thirtieth of June.
ex.zh: 她的生日是六月三十日。

ex.en: He was the thirtieth runner to finish.
ex.zh: 他是第三十个完成比赛的选手。

col: the thirtieth of June｜六月三十日
tip: 小学教材补充词：先听发音，再结合例句理解，最后用这个词说一句自己的话。
note: 依据小学教材词表整理；释义、例句与插画为本站补充内容，不属于词光官方原词条。

ex.en: Those flowers are very beautiful.
ex.zh: 那些花非常漂亮。

ex.en: Please put those on the top shelf.
ex.zh: 请把那些东西放在最上面的架子上。

tip: 小学教材补充词：先听发音，再结合例句理解，最后用这个词说一句自己的话。
note: 依据小学教材词表整理；释义、例句与插画为本站补充内容，不属于词光官方原词条。

senses.en: Despite the fact that something is true.
Used to introduce a contrasting point, often at sentence end.

ex.en: Though it was raining, we still walked to the bakery.
ex.zh: 虽然下着雨，我们还是步行去了面包店。

ex.en: Though online courses offer greater flexibility, many students still benefit from direct interaction with teachers.
ex.zh: 虽然线上课程更加灵活，但许多学生仍能从与教师的直接交流中获益。

tip: 引导让步从句时不与but连用；句末可表“不过”。

senses.en: an idea or opinion formed in the mind
the process of thinking carefully about something
past tense and past participle of think

ex.en: A sudden thought made me check my coat pocket.
ex.zh: 一个突然冒出的念头让我检查了一下外套口袋。

ex.en: Urban planning requires careful thought about how public spaces can serve people of different ages.
ex.zh: 城市规划需要仔细考虑公共空间如何服务不同年龄的人群。

col: give something some thought｜考虑某事
a sudden thought｜突然冒出的念头
food for thought｜引人深思的事物
tip: 表具体想法时可数；表思考过程时通常不可数。

senses.en: The number equal to ten hundreds.
A very large quantity, expressed as thousands.

ex.en: The repair cost nearly a thousand dollars in total.
ex.zh: 维修费总共将近一千美元。

ex.en: Several thousand residents have benefited from the new cycle routes connecting suburban neighbourhoods with the city centre.
ex.zh: 连接郊区社区与市中心的新自行车道已让数千名居民受益。

tip: 具体数词后不加s；泛指数千用thousands of。

ex.en: I have three good friends.
ex.zh: 我有三个好朋友。

ex.en: Please read the story three times.
ex.zh: 请把这个故事读三遍。

tip: 小学教材补充词：先听发音，再结合例句理解，最后用这个词说一句自己的话。
note: 依据小学教材词表整理；释义、例句与插画为本站补充内容，不属于词光官方原词条。

senses.en: the passage inside the neck through which air and food pass

ex.en: My throat felt dry after talking all afternoon.
ex.zh: 说了一下午话后，我觉得喉咙很干。

ex.en: Poor air quality can irritate the throat and worsen breathing problems, particularly among children and older adults.
ex.zh: 空气质量差会刺激咽喉并加重呼吸问题，儿童和老年人尤其容易受到影响。

tip: 喉咙痛用have a sore throat，注意冠词a。

senses.en: From one side or end to the other, within something.
By using a particular method, person, or process.
From beginning to end, or from one side to another.

ex.en: Sunlight streamed through the curtains and warmed the room.
ex.zh: 阳光透过窗帘洒进来，让房间暖和起来。

ex.en: Students can develop practical skills through projects that require cooperation and creative problem solving.
ex.zh: 学生可以通过需要合作和创造性解决问题的项目来培养实践技能。

tip: through强调从内部穿过；across强调横越表面。

senses.en: To send something through the air using your hand
To organise and host a party
An act of throwing, or the distance something is thrown

ex.en: Throw me the ball before the dog grabs it.
ex.zh: 趁狗还没抢到球，快把球扔给我。

ex.en: Schools can teach children to throw and catch safely through games that develop coordination and teamwork.
ex.zh: 学校可以通过培养协调能力和团队精神的游戏，教孩子安全地投接球。

tip: 不规则变化：throw–threw–thrown；聚会也可用throw。

senses.en: The loud sound in the sky caused by lightning
Produce thunder or make a similarly loud, deep noise

ex.en: A sudden clap of thunder made the windows shake.
ex.zh: 一声突如其来的雷鸣震得窗户直晃。

ex.en: Outdoor sports events should be suspended when thunder indicates that a storm is dangerously close.
ex.zh: 当雷声表明雷暴已逼近到危险距离时，应暂停户外体育赛事。

col: a clap of thunder｜一声雷响
a rumble of thunder｜低沉的隆隆雷声
tip: thunder指雷声，通常不可数；lightning指闪电。

senses.en: the day after Wednesday and before Friday

ex.en: We usually meet for lunch at home on Thursday.
ex.zh: 我们通常周四在家一起吃午饭。

ex.en: The university will host a public discussion on sustainable transport next Thursday evening.
ex.zh: 这所大学将于下周四晚举办一场关于可持续交通的公众讨论会。

tip: 星期名称首字母大写；具体某天前用on。

senses.en: To mark an item as correct, or make repeated clicking sounds.
A mark showing correctness, or a short sound a clock makes.
A small creature that attaches to skin and feeds on blood.

ex.en: The old clock ticks softly beside my bed.
ex.zh: 那只旧钟在我的床边轻轻地滴答作响。

ex.en: Participants should tick the appropriate boxes to indicate how frequently they use public transport.
ex.zh: 参与者应在相应方框内打钩，说明自己使用公共交通的频率。

col: tick a box｜在方框内打钩
a clock ticks｜钟表滴答作响
tip: “打钩”英式常用tick，美式常用check。

senses.en: A paper or electronic pass allowing travel or entry.
An official notice requiring payment for a traffic offence.
To give someone an official notice for a traffic offence.

ex.en: I bought a return ticket from the station machine.
ex.zh: 我在车站的售票机上买了一张往返票。

ex.en: Lower ticket prices could encourage more commuters to choose trains instead of driving to work.
ex.zh: 降低票价可以鼓励更多通勤者选择乘火车而非开车上班。

tip: 英式single/return ticket分别指单程票和往返票。

senses.en: Neatly arranged, with everything in its proper place.
To put things in order and make a place neat.

ex.en: Her desk stays tidy, even during the busiest weeks.
ex.zh: 即使在最忙的几周里，她的书桌也保持整洁。

ex.en: Keeping shared workplaces tidy can help employees find equipment quickly and create a more pleasant environment.
ex.zh: 保持共用工作场所整洁，有助于员工迅速找到设备，并营造更舒适的环境。

tip: tidy强调摆放整齐；clean强调没有污垢。

senses.en: to fasten something using string, rope, or a knot
a long narrow piece of cloth worn around the collar
a connection between people, groups, or places

ex.en: Please tie your shoelaces before you run outside.
ex.zh: 跑出去之前，请先系好鞋带。

ex.en: Strong ties between schools and local employers can help young people make a smoother transition into work.
ex.zh: 学校与当地雇主之间的紧密联系，可以帮助年轻人更顺利地进入职场。

tip: tie的现在分词是tying；表示关系时通常用复数ties。

senses.en: A large wild cat with dark stripes on orange fur

ex.en: The tiger rested in the shade beside a pool.
ex.zh: 那只老虎在水池旁的阴凉处休息。

ex.en: Protecting tiger habitats also helps conserve other species that share the same forest ecosystems.
ex.zh: 保护老虎栖息地也有助于保护同一森林生态系统中的其他物种。

tip: 可数名词；一只老虎用a tiger。

senses.en: Fitting closely or held firmly, with little room to move.
Leaving very little extra time, money, or space.
Firmly and securely, without becoming loose.

ex.en: These shoes are too tight around my toes.
ex.zh: 这双鞋的鞋头太紧，挤着我的脚趾。

ex.en: Schools operating on tight budgets may struggle to provide students with modern equipment and adequate support.
ex.zh: 预算紧张的学校可能难以为学生提供现代化设备和充分的支持。

col: a tight deadline｜很紧的截止期限
tip: tight本身可作副词，如hold tight；tightly也表紧紧地。

senses.en: up to a particular time
up to the time when something happens
a machine or drawer where a shop keeps cash

ex.en: The little bakery stays open till six every evening.
ex.zh: 这家小面包店每天晚上营业到六点。

ex.en: Some parents work till late evening, making affordable childcare essential for families in urban areas.
ex.zh: 有些家长工作到深夜，因此价格可负担的托育服务对城市家庭至关重要。

tip: till与until意思相同；作连词谈将来时通常接一般现在时。

senses.en: what clocks measure, or a particular point in its passage
an occasion when something happens
to measure duration or choose when something should happen

ex.en: We still have time for a walk before dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭前我们还有时间散步。

ex.en: Schools should give students enough time to explore creative activities alongside their preparation for formal examinations.
ex.zh: 学校应在学生准备正式考试的同时，给予他们足够的时间探索创意活动。

col: spend time doing something｜花时间做某事
tip: 时间通常不可数；表示次数时可数，如three times。

senses.en: Extremely small in size or amount.

ex.en: A tiny frog jumped out of the flower pot.
ex.zh: 一只小小的青蛙从花盆里跳了出来。

ex.en: Even tiny changes in daily habits can reduce household energy consumption over time.
ex.zh: 即使日常习惯的微小改变，长期下来也能减少家庭能源消耗。

tip: 比small语气更强，强调小得惊人。

senses.en: a useful piece of advice
the narrow or pointed end of something
extra money given to someone for providing a service

ex.en: My neighbour shared a useful tip for growing tomatoes.
ex.zh: 邻居分享了一个种番茄的实用窍门。

ex.en: Schools can offer practical tips on managing money to help young people develop responsible spending habits.
ex.zh: 学校可以提供实用的理财建议，帮助年轻人养成负责任的消费习惯。

col: the tip of the tongue｜舌尖
tip: tip作“建议”可数，advice不可数：a tip。

senses.en: needing rest or sleep because of physical or mental effort
annoyed or bored by something that continues or repeats

ex.en: I felt too tired to cook after the walk.
ex.zh: 散步后我累得不想做饭。

ex.en: Employees who regularly work long hours may become too tired to perform their duties safely.
ex.zh: 经常长时间工作的员工可能会疲惫不堪，无法安全地履行职责。

col: too tired to concentrate｜累得无法集中注意力
tip: tired形容人感到累；tiring形容事情令人累。

senses.en: making someone feel that they need rest

ex.en: Carrying these heavy bags upstairs is tiring work.
ex.zh: 把这些沉重的袋子搬上楼是件累人的活。

ex.en: Long and tiring commutes can reduce workers' productivity and leave them with less time for family activities.
ex.zh: 漫长而累人的通勤会降低员工的工作效率，也会减少他们参与家庭活动的时间。

col: a tiring journey｜令人疲惫的旅程
tip: tiring形容事物令人累；tired形容人感到累。

senses.en: the name given to a book, film, or other work
a name indicating someone's rank, position, or professional role
the position of winner in a sporting competition

ex.en: I remember the book's cover but not its title.
ex.zh: 我记得这本书的封面，却不记得书名了。

ex.en: An effective essay title should clearly indicate the main issue being discussed without revealing every detail.
ex.zh: 好的文章标题应清楚表明所讨论的主要问题，而不必透露所有细节。

tip: title是标题或名称；topic是讨论的主题。
